arg.name: ego
arg.description: the ego's YAML: default (aib's deps/autoware_isaac_bridge/src/aib/config/ego.yaml: aib's Tesla Model 3, a PhysX vehicle with Autoware's sensors and vehicle interface), none (037's kinematic box) or a path to an aib ego config

arg.name: world
arg.description: worlds to preload, comma separated: world files (map/isaac/world.yaml), map directories or USD files; the first stays loaded; none: nothing

arg.name: follow
arg.description: true: with a window, no UI and a viewport chasing the ego; editor: the chase with Isaac's editor UI kept; false: the editor's own camera

arg.name: record
arg.description: a directory for each scenario's first ego's dash and wheel pictures and soil state (a video's); empty: none

arg.name: record_view
arg.description: with record: the pictures' size and chase camera: offroad (960 x 540, high, behind and to the left) or road (1280 x 720, 7 m behind, 3.4 m up, 15 deg down, 80 deg: the NTU twin's, as on CARLA)

arg.name: render
arg.description: auto (a window on DISPLAY when set, unless ISAAC_HEADLESS=1) | window | headless

arg.name: physics_hz
arg.description: the physics rate, Hz (PhysX, the egos' onboard computers, the soil); the bridge splits each SSv2 step into steps no longer than 1 / this. The ego's commands are taken once per SSv2 step

arg.name: state_dir
arg.description: where the server writes for a map, and a project's own map files: state_dir/map/ (ruts, surfaces.yaml, road_detail.yaml, a course world's props link); empty: into the map directory

arg.name: wheels_topic
arg.description: true: publish /swb/wheels on the ego's domain (diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray, one status per ego wheel: class, zone, friction, slip_ratio, slip_angle, sinkage, normal_load; 20 Hz of sim time)

node.name: swb_isaac_world
node.args: --port $(env ISAAC_PORT 5590) --ego $(var ego) --ego-domain $(env EGO_ROS_DOMAIN_ID 1) --world $(var world) --follow $(var follow) --render $(var render) --record=$(var record) --record-view $(var record_view) --physics-hz $(var physics_hz) --state-dir=$(var state_dir) --wheels-topic $(var wheels_topic)
